## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Refactoring

## Safety & Principles Checklist
- [ ] Strictly read-only: no files are modified, created, or deleted in user repositories.
- [ ] Offline-first: zero network requests or socket calls.
- [ ] Zero runtime external dependencies: utilizes standard library.
- [ ] Zero telemetry or analytics.

## Testing
- [ ] Added unit / integration tests.
- [ ] All tests pass (`pytest`).
- [ ] Linter checks pass (`ruff check .`).
